positive_source_basis: Verify the named finished product in FSSR Chapter 2.4.15(1) and its exact physical form; do not rely only on FoSCoS category.
Check actual cereal, pulse, oilseed/nut, oil or spice ingredients. Broad biscuit identity does not itself prove a listed article.

Obtain actual finished-product bill of materials plus batch recipe with positive botanical source identity of a CTR-listed cereal/cereal product, pulse, nut, oilseed/oil, spice, dried fig or arecanut/betelnut; qualification is not assumed.
Review CTR IX §2.2.1 named finished composite food articles: Total Aflatoxins 20 µg/kg and Aflatoxin B1 10 µg/kg; do not transfer any raw-commodity threshold unchanged.
Validate recipe, manufacturing process, retained ingredient matrix, sample definition, analytical methods, effective date and any more-specific rule before assigning an actual lot limit or PASS.
negative_transfer_controls: FoSCoS biscuit/pasta/noodle/papad names treated as proof of a listed cereal, pulse, oilseed, nut or spice.
Tuber-only pasta/noodle, starch-only biscuits, and fruit/vegetable-only papad treated as automatically qualified.
Raw cereal, oilseed, pulse or spice toxin limits transplanted to the different finished food.
Assuming a filling, frying oil or seasoning is part of the final sampled matrix without bill-of-material and sampling confirmation.
Using FSSR moisture, ash, acidity or protein quality criteria as evidence of contaminant measurements.
Automatic finished-lot numerical contaminant application, complete contaminant testing or regulatory PASS.
